'''Podcasts, video and interviews''' about the ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game have been published since Decipher's own weekly audio show, [[Radio Free Decipher]], began on 4 December 1998. After the [[Players Committee]] took over the game in 2002, players and the PC moved to live streams, YouTube channels, interview podcasts and tournament footage. This page lists every channel, show, stream, podcast and interview series known to the wiki, grouped by kind.

Each table gives the host or creator, the years the source was active, its size, and the wiki page that covers it. Sizes for YouTube channels are the total uploads in each channel's uploads list as of 15 October 2026; where a channel covers other games too, the number of ''Star Wars'' CCG uploads follows in brackets.
